surface_mechanism_description: The ALD process involves alternating pulses of precursor gas separated by purging, with the Al2O3 precursors being water and trimethylaluminum (TMA) and the HfO2 precursors being water and tetrakis(dimethylamido)hafnium. The growth rates are expressed as a thickness obtained per cycle, although the mechanisms of ALD growth are more complex.
